preconditions: Trusted 0.2.0 Core type registry; owned inert common-field JSON fixtures.
steps: Validate versioned common-field envelopes; compare accepted identities and rejection diagnostics.

oracle.requirement_contract: Jedes reguläre 0.2-Artefakt MUSS die gemeinsamen Pflichtfelder aus Kapitel 9.3 enthalten; historisch unveränderbare Ressourcen werden ausschließlich nach Anhang Q gelesen.
oracle.scope: Common-field schema resources and read-only projections only. This is not a complete artifact acceptance, approval, release or creation gate.

open_items: Common projection only: nested relations, provenance, external identities, SRX and complete BCP-47 validation remain with their later contracts. Type-specific schemas, graph/profile rules, lifecycle authorization, artifact creation and historical-resource adapters are not provided by this layer.
